page.overview:
Who is Nathaniel Elton?

Nathaniel Elton is a fictional character created by Chaosium for their horror-roleplaying game Call of Cthulhu, making his first appearance in the supplement The Complete Dreamlands

Nathaniel Elton is the grandson of Basil Elton, the protagonist of H. P. Lovecraft's 1919 short story "The White Ship." In the expanded Cthulhu Mythos of Call of Cthulhu Elton, with the help of fellow dreamer Ward Phillips, was able to navigate the one safe path through the Basalt Pillars of the West to reach Cathuria. (: The Complete Dreamlands).

Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works Category:Dreamers
